events_per_year.basis: developing faults per duty pump that would otherwise end in an unplanned stop

unplanned_stop_h.basis: detection by failure, diagnosis, parts, repair

planned_stop_h.basis: the same work prepared and done in a planned window

downtime_cost_eur_h.basis: production loss of a mid-size line with no redundant pump

repair_unplanned_eur.basis: within a typical EUR 3-15 k pump overhaul range (itself an estimate)

false_alert_cost_eur.basis: about 1.5 h of technician time to check one false alert

repeat_alert_cost_eur.basis: a repeat on a problem already known is a glance, not a check (our assumption)

capex_eur.basis: BOM option B about EUR 2.1-2.4 k from list prices plus cabling, enclosure and installation

opex_eur_yr.basis: connectivity, software maintenance, battery and sensor replacement
